units.rawText: Odette?

units.rawText: Big... sis...

units.rawText: It seems it is curtains for this production at last.

spans.text: It seems it is curtains for this production at last.

units.rawText: Odile mutters to herself as she stares at where her little sister had vanished. The purple on her has darkened compared to before.

spans.text: Odile mutters to herself as she stares at where her little sister had vanished. The purple on her has darkened compared to before.

units.rawText: But if my recollections of her Tertiary Layer aren't wrong, Odette should have vanished long ago.

units.rawText: How could she appear again here?

units.displayText: I've got a theory. Do you remember the hierarchical control system that the Entropics have?

spans.text: I've got a theory. Do you remember the hierarchical control system that the Entropics have?

units.rawText: Also, the Odile fighting us has more computational power, but her combat and leadership reflexes aren't what they were before.

units.rawText: Otherwise, there's no way she wouldn't have noticed how obviously we were communicating with the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: So Odile partitioned off part of her neural cloud into Odette, then...

units.rawText: Then it would make sense for her to be able to partition her neural cloud into a Low-Order Entropic and turn it into a clone.

units.rawText: That was why Odile knew everything about what was happening on both sides, because she was always directing the battle on both fronts.

spans.text: That was why Odile knew everything about what was happening on both sides, because she was always directing the battle on both fronts.

units.rawText: But why would she go out of her way to make her clone look like her little sister?
units.displayText: But why would she go out of her way to make her clone look like her little sister?

spans.text: But why would she go out of her way to make her clone look like her little sister?

units.rawText: We can't hope to understand how a lunatic thinks.
units.displayText: We can't hope to understand how a lunatic thinks.

units.displayText: What's important is that this little sister is every bit as dangerous as Odile.

spans.text: What's important is that this little sister is every bit as dangerous as Odile.

units.rawText: If our theory is correct and she's just a Low-Order Entropic that's been taken over, then, in theory, she can instantly change Odette's host at any time, effectively teleporting her.
units.displayText: If our theory is correct and she's just a Low-Order Entropic that's been taken over, then, in theory, she can instantly change Odette's host at any time, effectively teleporting her.

units.rawText: Yes... That's way too dangerous! I'll inform Croque and Sol right away!
units.displayText: Yes... That's way too dangerous! I'll inform Croque and Sol right away!

units.rawText: Yep, let's do that.

units.rawText: I see. Regrettably, I have had too little experience fighting Entropics and was not aware they could perform such things.

units.rawText: Humph, all you blockheads who bang on about martial valor and whatnot know how to do is exterminate Entropics when you catch them without even bothering to analyze them.

units.rawText: And then we'll go on the offensive. Antonina, can you pin her down with a DDoS attack?
